Person Information:
Name: Alex Petrov
Age: 32
Lives in Ohrid, North Macedonia
Uses both personal and work emails frequently.

Other Services Used:
Amazon account for work purchases and personal orders (emails from @amazon.com).
PayPal for international transactions (emails from @paypal.com).
Microsoft Outlook used for email (official notices do not come from random domains like outlook-mailservices.com).

Company Information:
Employer: NovaTech Solutions
Position: Software Engineer
Email: alex.petrov@novatech.com
Main contacts: HR (Sarah Ling), Finance, and IT.
Official company domains: novatech.com, novatech.mk.
HR, Finance and IT emails always come from @novatech.com, not from similar domains like novatech-support.com.

Bank and Payment Information:
Main Bank: Macedonian Bank (mkbank.com)
Account uses online banking portal frequently.
PayPal and Amazon accounts linked to main bank card.
Legitimate bank emails always come from @mkbank.com, never from look-alike domains such as mkbank-verify.com.

How to Play: That's Not Your Email

Game Overview
You're Alex Petrov, a software engineer from Ohrid. Your inbox has 20 emails from work, bank, and services. Some are real, some are scams.

Your Mission
Open the Mail app → Check the 20 emails in the floating Gmail-style window → For each email press the button 'REAL' or 'SCAM'.

 Use Clues
Open Notepad app → Read your personal info, company details, bank accounts, and trusted email domains. Compare sender addresses carefully!

 Winning
Get 16+ correct → You spot all scams and stay safe!
Get 12-15 correct → Good job, but watch for look-alike domains next time.
Less than 12 → Scammers got you—review the notes and try again!


 Pro Tips
- Check sender domain (novatech.com vs novatech-support.com)
- Real companies never ask for bank info via email

Good luck, Alex!
